### Configuring Allowed Hosts via run_http_async

Source: https://github.com/prefecthq/fastmcp/blob/main/fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/mixins/transport.py

The run_http_async method accepts allowed_hosts and allowed_origins parameters which can be passed directly or read from settings. When running behind a load balancer with a custom domain, these can be specified to override settings.

